items.problem: The spec says "the n-th value from the right of `X-Forwarded-For`" but does not set how that value is taken from the header. It does not say whether whitespace around `,` is trimmed (the usual form is `a, b`), or what the client IP is when the value is not a bare IP address (e.g. `unknown`, `203.0.113.5:4711`, `[2001:db8::1]`). Implementations can differ in the IP counter `target`, the `ip_in_cidrs` result of admin-api and cheat, and the truncated IP. This was there before the diff, which only adds the IPv4-mapped rule
